status: in progress: see each job status and qa
overwritePolicy: never overwrite an existing output; reruns get a new tag (_v2, _r2b ...) with a new prompt file and a new output path; rejected images stay in place or in _rejected/

runner.builtinTool: codex exec --enable image_generation (built-in image_gen only; no image_gen.py, no API key)

scale.rule: every cell carries its own 1H marker at the cell-local scale, drawn by code in the attached frame; sizes are PROPOSALS, not canon
scale.hLabelNote: measure against the drawn human, not against the drawn guide lines (AD 6.5)

environmentLayoutRule: Per sheet 6 numbered cells in a 3x2 grid, one asset per cell, a 1H (1.8 m) marker in every cell from a code-drawn scale frame (AD 6.5) attached as image 2. Perspective sheet first; the turnaround depends on it and attaches the selected perspective as identity reference (AD 7.2).
styleReferenceRule: AD 1.3: "match ONLY the painting style and level of detail; do NOT copy its colours, layout or design"
moodReferenceRule: no map-mood reference: concept sheets carry no map mood (AD 2); warm mid-grey studio backdrop
materialReferenceRule: A21 attaches a Gaussian-blurred (r 2.2) crop of the earlier A17.1 leaning-stones cell as a redraw reference with WRONG IN THE REFERENCE lines (AD 1.3)
promptBlocks: STYLE CORE 3.1 + SHEET RULES 3.2 + ENVIRONMENT RULES 3.7 + Sheet-6 block + CONTENT 3.8 pasted verbatim from ashlar/artdirection.md v2.0, then the asset-specific text
notes: Asset list, designs and sizes are proposals (Đề xuất AD) from tmp/act1-base-maps/MISSING_ENV_CONCEPTS_2.md; not canon, not the final Act I layout.
Whitewash, linen and chalk whites have no canon HEX (biome doc BIO-05 / BIO-06a): described in words, never as the glowing Seamless white or the Act III salt white.

Frames, blurred references, prompts and this manifest are generated by session tooling in E:/act1-env-batch/v3 (make_frames_v3.py = make_frames.py on spec_v3, build_v3.py); the images only by Astra built-in image_gen.
